_why: Each radius value is the most crates that may rebuild and retest when the crate changes, across every Cargo workspace of the repo (today's measured radius; a crate not listed has none). It only shrinks: lower a value when `wf check --blast-radius` reports a shrink; raise one only with the owner's reason in the commit message. A crate name two workspaces share is keyed `name (dir)`. allowed_edges maps 'low-level -> heavy' to the reason an existing edge stays. allowed_unused maps 'crate -> dependency' to the reason a declared-but-unnamed workspace dependency stays; it only shrinks.
